text_changes.before: Deterministic: extract all four-digit years 2015-2030 from the activity span and its context, plus the calendar years named by any fiscal-year label there; a label spanning two calendar years gives both. A year range gives both its end years, even outside 2015-2030, unless a numbering word such as "p.", "No." or "§" comes just before it; a two-digit end year counts only in a fiscal-year label. No fallback to publication year. Across chunks: earliest chosen year.
text_changes.after: Deterministic: extract all four-digit years 2015-2030 from the activity span and its context, plus the calendar years named by any fiscal-year label there and the years written in the Japanese era (with the era name), the Buddhist Era (with its marker) or the ROC calendar (民國), converted to CE; a label spanning two calendar years gives both. A year range gives both its end years, even outside 2015-2030, unless a numbering word such as "p.", "No." or "§" comes just before it; a two-digit end year counts only in a fiscal-year label. A two-digit year is read as 20xx, except that those from (current year mod 100) + 25 through 99 are read as 19xx. No fallback to publication year. Across chunks: earliest chosen year.
